Description: ReplayGuard: bounded, expiring SQS/Lambda failure lab and independent simulated fulfillment receipts.

LabExpiresAt.Description: UTC Unix epoch after which both Lambdas reject fulfillment; deploy script permits 1-48 hours, default 24. Delete stack after use.

ReservedConcurrency.Description: Use 2 when the regional quota permits reservations. Use -1 for low-quota student accounts; the private SQS mapping still caps worker concurrency at 2.
